pick.headline: Enrile and Ramos revolt against Marcos
pick.summary: On 22 February 1986 Defence Minister Juan Ponce Enrile and armed forces vice-chief Fidel Ramos broke with President Ferdinand Marcos, setting off the People Power revolution.
pick.significance: Crowds protected the rebels at Camp Aguinaldo. Within three days Marcos, long backed by Washington, had fled.

alternates.headline: Bush gives Iraq ultimatum to leave Kuwait
alternates.summary: On 22 February 1991 President Bush gave Iraq until noon Washington time the next day to begin a large-scale withdrawal from Kuwait.
alternates.significance: The ultimatum rejected a Soviet peace plan's terms and preceded the coalition ground offensive.
